scope: 疎な倍数ゼータ/メビウス変換の再提出確認と追加候補の比較。

decision.retained: 現行の大素数count1分離＋GCC小型値型8回展開。

rejected.class4/8/32: 分岐をまとめた連続キー判定。GCCの100万要素API往復は約1〜3%後退。
rejected.xor16/32: XOR/ORで不一致を集約。GCCは後退。Clang plain APIではxor16が約5%改善したが、nativeの100万要素は約0.6%、固定mainはばらつきと区別できる改善なし。
rejected.narrow16/32: XORをキー幅に限定。GCC大規模やClang他条件で一貫した改善なし。
rejected.div32: 篩のint上限を使い商だけunsigned幅で計算。大規模はほぼ同等、他条件で微退行。

decision.reason: GCC対象の固定mainで明確な短縮がなく、分岐・コード規模を増やす根拠が不足。現行の速度と単純さを維持。限界速度を証明したものではない。

proof.nonempty: f.empty() returns before this branch, so dense_size>=1 and initial i=1<=dense_size.
proof.block_bounds: dense_size-i>16 implies i+15<=dense_size-2. All16 key reads are interior positions, and every expected i+j+1<=dense_size-1 fits size_t. After i+=16, i<=dense_size-1, preserving subtraction safety.
proof.scalar_tail: After blocks, scalar loop covers each remaining interior key once. i+1<=dense_size in all evaluated nonempty-size tail cases, except singleton initial i1 where i+1=2 is independently safe.
proof.equivalence: Unsigned OR of unsigned XOR terms is zero iff every term is zero. uintmax_t represents every size_t value, so each term compares exactly the same converted key and expected index as the old scalar classifier. No XOR cancellation is possible under OR.
proof.key_types: bool and narrow keys use no make_unsigned or narrowing. Signed-negative conversion to uintmax_t is identical to old classifier. uint64 keys are represented by uintmax_t without loss.
proof.exception_order: Integer key reads, conversions and bitwise operations do not throw or touch Val. A mismatch may cause up to15 extra valid key reads but arithmetic, allocation, sorting and exception order remain identical.
proof.compiler_guard: Restricting this classifier to Clang changes only code generation selection; other compilers retain old scalar classifier.

risks: No implementation bug found. Do not substitute XOR accumulation for OR accumulation: XOR could cancel two nonzero mismatches.
The existing outer endpoint checks and the scalar remainder must remain present.
review.decision: Reject this round; retain production. Correct candidate but no convincing fixed-main or GCC benefit.
